subject: world_language
concept: Asking for and giving simple directions in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR A2 'ask/give simple directions' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student physically follows spoken directions (turn left, go straight) given in the target language
exercise.pictorial: Student traces a route on a simple map matching spoken directions
exercise.abstract: Student writes or says a simple set of directions in the target language

misconception_flags: confuses left/right or other directional terms in the target language

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
